what: the day's ranked clusters, in the desk's own one line, sources counted and linked (Jack, 5 October 2026)
what_a_wire_line_is: Each line is the desk's own one-line summary of a story it ranked, with its sources counted and linked. It is not a story the desk wrote or checked; only the item with a badge was checked.

items.line: U.S. CPI accelerated to 3.7% in September, exceeding forecasts and sparking a crypto sell-off as rate-hike odds climbed.
titles: U.S. September CPI comes in hot, sending bitcoin sharply lower

items.line: Turkish police detained HEX and PulseChain founder Richard Heart on an Interpol Red Notice, seizing $4 million in cash and crypto equipment.

items.line: Payward, Kraken's parent, agreed to acquire Lithuania's Saldo Bank, becoming the first crypto firm to secure an EU banking license.

items.line: Dutch central bank granted Qivalis an e-money license under MiCA rules, enabling onchain euro settlement backed by three major European banks.

items.line: Solana announced October 21 activation of Alpenglow upgrade, targeting 150-millisecond finality and replacing its TowerBFT voting system.
titles: Solana sets Oct. 21 for Alpenglow upgrade targeting 150-millisecond finality

checked.says: Decrypt reports Turkish authorities detained Richard Heart in Istanbul on an Interpol Red Notice issued by Finland, with seizures including cash, electronics, and weapons.
checked.unconfirmed: The specific $4M cash figure cited in why_it_matters was not confirmed in the excerpts read; Decrypt and CryptoSlate report 'large amount of cash in different currencies' and 'cash' but no dollar amount is stated in the fetched text.
